title: Who’s Trading Now?
hook: Before you read the chart, read you.

launchpad.outcome: Check your own state before a session, and catch who is making the decision in the moment.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Who is trading right now: the trader, or the feeling?

say: By now you’ve met them all.
The win. The heater. The loss. The streak. “I knew it.” Frozen. The candle you can’t stop watching. One more. Boredom. The bills.
They don’t show up one at a time. They show up in the middle of a normal Tuesday.

choice.prompt: 9:58. You lost yesterday. A valid setup forms. Your stomach drops.

options.label: Notice it, check the rule, take it

say: The feeling came along. The trader made the decision.
That wasn’t a decision about this chart. Yesterday made it.

choice.prompt: 10:20. +2R on the day. Your plan says done.
10:41. You’re in a trade, +15, and a red candle prints.

options.label: Close it to protect the green

say: Fear made that one. No rule triggered.

options.label: Hold. Nothing in the plan changed.

say: Same person. Same morning. Different traders, minute to minute.
The skill isn’t never feeling it. It’s noticing who just took the mouse.

beats.principle: BEFORE EVERY CLICK: WHO’S TRADING NOW?

slides.title: Read you first
slides.body: Where would you put each thought? This is for noticing, not grading yourself.
slides.punch: A red state doesn’t make the setup invalid. It makes your personal rules matter more. (That’s Section 2.)

slides.title: Write the state down, not just the trade

example.plannedResponse: Pause and require the full checklist

slides.punch: Private to you. Never shared, never ranked.

slides.quote: I check my chart before every session. I check myself first.

slides.prompt: Which version of you shows up most often, and when?
slides.modelAnswer: I notice which feeling shows up and when: after a loss, after a win, when I’m bored, when money is tight. Before every click I ask who is trading right now.

takeaways: Before every click: who’s trading now?
remember: BEFORE EVERY CLICK: WHO’S TRADING NOW?
